field_descriptions.accepted_offer: The offer(s) -- e.g., product, quantity and price combinations -- included in the order.
field_descriptions.billing_address: The billing address for the order.
field_descriptions.broker: An entity that arranges for an exchange between a buyer and a seller.  In most cases a broker never acquires or releases ownership of a product or service involved in an exchange.  If it is not clear whether an entity is a broker, seller, or buyer, the latter two terms are preferred.
field_descriptions.confirmation_number: A number that confirms the given order or payment has been received.
field_descriptions.customer: Party placing the order or paying the invoice.
field_descriptions.discount_code: Code used to redeem a discount.
field_descriptions.discount_currency: The currency of the discount.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.is_gift: Indicates whether the offer was accepted as a gift for someone other than the buyer.
field_descriptions.order_delivery: The delivery of the parcel related to this order or order item.
field_descriptions.order_status: The current status of the order.
field_descriptions.part_of_invoice: The order is being paid as part of the referenced Invoice.
field_descriptions.payment_due: The date that payment is due.
field_descriptions.payment_due_date: The date that payment is due.
field_descriptions.payment_method: The name of the credit card or other method of payment for the order.
field_descriptions.payment_method_id: An identifier for the method of payment used (e.g. the last 4 digits of the credit card).
field_descriptions.payment_url: The URL for sending a payment.
field_descriptions.seller: An entity which offers (sells / leases / lends / loans) the services / goods.  A seller may also be a provider.
